requirements_summary: Primary workload: chat-based support copilot + semantic search/rerank. Targets: p50 chat <200ms, p95 <600ms; steady throughput ~150 req/s with spikes to 400 req/s. Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit to Dedicated if unit economics competitive. Must support EU data residency (customer data segmented), SSO/SAML, audit logs, retention controls, KMS integration. POC scope: Dedicated reserved capacity proof-of-concept with canary rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%), fallback routing to cheaper quantized model variant on high latency/errors, region failover plan (eu-west primary, us-west warm standby), automated rollback criteria (error rate >3% or p95 >1s for >5 min), and tracing hooks for per-token cost + latency.
